mu_name_from: The Dungeon's object slot 48, the model index: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd (MapManager.cpp:1121-1123).
sheet_from: Data/Object2/, from MuMain, decoded under a dn_ prefix: assets/textures is one flat pool, and wood01 and TileRock01 are other worlds' names too. TileRock01 is byte for byte World2's own, so the rocks wear the ground's copy.
why_this_one: A cave rock, 235 of them, scaled up to 3.2: a tall leaning spike of TileRock01 that stands in Dungeon 3's cave as a stalagmite, often round a wall torch MU set inside the rocks. Seen in the world 2026-09-30 at 204,176.
